|echo concurrent_history_marker
|history

== frame redirected cursor=10,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ history
|echo concurrent_history_marker
|history
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ history > history-output
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cat history-output
|echo concurrent_history_marker
|history
|history > history-output
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
